one_off_chores.name: Clean kitchen counters
one_off_chores.description:
## Kitchen reset

- Clear every work surface.
- Wipe counters with a **clean, damp cloth**.
- Dry around the sink.

> Use a separate cloth for food preparation areas.

one_off_chores.name: Feed sourdough starter
one_off_chores.description:
1. Keep **25 g** of starter.
2. Add 50 g flour and 50 g water.
3. Mix and loosely cover the jar.

Mark the starting level.
Leave at *room temperature* until doubled.

one_off_chores.name: Back up photos
one_off_chores.description:
## Photo backup

Copy recent photos into `household-backup/photos`.

1. Connect the backup drive.
2. Copy new albums.
3. Open a few copied photos to verify them.

**Keep the originals** until verification is complete.

See the [3-2-1 backup strategy](https://www.backblaze.com/blog/the-3-2-1-backup-strategy/).

scheduled_chores.name: Water houseplants
scheduled_chores.description:
## Check before watering

- Feel the top layer of soil.
- Water **only if dry**.
- Empty excess water from saucers.

> Succulents need less water than leafy plants.

Rotate pots a little for *even growth*.
